change.title: Change company data
change.forbidden: Only the Company Admin changes the data of the company (HTTP 403).
change.notEditable: The data of your company cannot be changed in its current state.

wallet.title: Verify with your Business Wallet
wallet.text: A person who may represent the company confirms with the EUDI Wallet. The current data of your Business Wallet is taken over.
wallet.changes: Changes: legal name, address, EUID. Country and EBWOID must stay the same.
wallet.unavailable: The confirmation with the EUDI Wallet runs through the EBW-Connector of your onboarding service provider. That flow of the portal backend is not specified yet, so the portal cannot start it. Use a change request in the meantime.

request.tag: Checked by your onboarding service provider
request.title: Request a change with documents
request.text: Send the new values with supporting documents. Your onboarding service provider checks them and decides.
request.changes: Changes: VAT ID, commercial register number, LEI code, EORI; legal name and address only without a Business Wallet.

change.coreDataLocked: They come from your Business Wallet and change only with it.
change.identifiersHelp: The complete list after the change. Identifiers from your Business Wallet stay as they are.
change.comment: Comment for your onboarding service provider
change.documentsExample: For example an extract from the commercial register or the LEI certificate.
change.dropFiles: Drop files here or choose files
change.documentsHelp: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to {{maxMb}} MB each, at most {{max}} files.
change.submittedText: Your onboarding service provider checks your change request. You see the decision in your change requests.

requests.title: Your change requests
requests.subtitle: Changes of your company data with supporting documents. Your onboarding service provider decides on them.
requests.forbidden: You do not have the permission to see the change requests of your company (HTTP 403).
requests.approvedOn: Approved on {{date}}. Your company data was changed.
requests.checking: Your onboarding service provider is checking your change request.
requests.documentsNote: Only your onboarding service provider opens the documents.
requests.emptyText: To change identifiers such as the VAT ID or the LEI code, send a change request with supporting documents.
requests.withdrawText: Your onboarding service provider will not decide on “{{summary}}”. You can send a new change request afterwards.

roleCards.title: Company roles
roleCards.subtitle: The roles of {{company}} in {{dataspace}}. A role is active once your company has accepted its terms.
roleCards.acceptFor: To add the role {{role}}, accept its terms for {{company}}:
roleCards.removeText: {{company}} loses the role {{role}}. The consents to its terms are withdrawn, unless another active role needs them.

companies.title: Companies
companies.subtitle: Every company of your onboarding service provider, from the application to the deactivation.
companies.forbidden: Only staff of the onboarding service provider see all companies (HTTP 403).

detail.title: Company
detail.notFound: There is no company with this ID at your onboarding service provider.
detail.inactive: Deactivated {{date}} · {{reason}}. The data cannot be corrected while the company is deactivated.
detail.openRequest: This company has an open change request.
detail.correctSubtitle: The correction is stored with your reason in the audit log.
detail.correctWalletWarning: The core data of this company comes from its Business Wallet. If you change the legal name or the address, the source becomes “Checked by the onboarding service provider” and the link to the verification is removed.
detail.countryLocked: Locked: the CSP knows the company with this country since the BPN was assigned.
detail.correctReasonPlaceholder: For example: hint from the application review, register extract of 05 Nov 2026
detail.correctReasonHelp: Required, up to 500 characters. Stored in the audit log.
detail.correctedManual: Correction saved. The core data is now checked by the onboarding service provider.
detail.deactivateIntro: {{name}} stays in the dataspace records, but for as long as it is deactivated:

consequences.accounts: its people keep their accounts but lose the company, its portal roles and app roles;
consequences.technicalUsers: its technical users are deactivated, not deleted;
consequences.credential: its membership credential is revoked; the BPN credential stays;
consequences.membership: its membership in the dataspace is deregistered at the CSP;
consequences.data: its data can no longer be changed. Its dataspace wallet remains.

detail.reactivationHint: A person with a mandate can apply for reactivation.
detail.deactivateReasonHelp: Required, up to 500 characters. Only in the audit log; the company does not see it.

csp.title: CSP registration
csp.subtitle: How the core service provider of {{dataspace}} knows {{name}}
csp.loading: Loading the registration at the CSP…
csp.forbidden: Only the OSP Admin sees the registration at the CSP (HTTP 403).
csp.cardSubtitle: The core service provider knows the company by its BPN, with your onboarding service provider as home OSP.
csp.notRegisteredShort: Not registered at the CSP yet.
csp.notRegisteredTitle: Not registered at the CSP yet
csp.notRegisteredText: {{name}} has no registration at the core service provider. The registration starts after the application is approved.
csp.note: The status is read from the CSP connection of your onboarding service provider. The steps run on their own after the approval of the application; there is nothing to start here.

REGISTERED.title: {{dataspace}} knows {{name}} by {{bpn}}
REGISTERED.text: Your onboarding service provider is its home OSP. Only it may change the company at the CSP.

PENDING.title: The CSP is processing the registration
PENDING.text: The BPN arrives when the CSP confirms the registration. The company stays Requested until then.

FAILED.title: The CSP rejected the registration
FAILED.text: {{reason}} The company stays Requested without a BPN.

TRANSFERRED_AWAY.title: The company moved to another OSP
TRANSFERRED_AWAY.text: The CSP reported the transfer {{date}}. The BPN stays the same; your onboarding service provider no longer manages the company.

register.title: Registered at the CSP
register.help: The CSP assigns or confirms the business partner number (BPN) and enters the home OSP of the company.

did.title: DID in the BPN → DID directory
did.help: Partners find the dataspace wallet of the company from its BPN.

membership.title: Member of {{dataspace}}
membership.help: Only members are named in the discovery of the CSP; their connectors can be found.

steps.didAfterWallet: Entered after the dataspace wallet exists
steps.newHome: Now managed by the new home OSP

queue.title: Change requests to review
queue.subtitle: Companies ask to change their data with supporting documents. The oldest request comes first.
queue.forbidden: Only the staff of the onboarding service provider review change requests (HTTP 403).
queue.emptyText: Every request is decided. New ones appear here.
queue.noMatchTitle: No change request matches the filter

review.title: Review change request
review.notFound: This change request does not exist.

effect.MANUAL: On approval the data changes at once and counts as checked by the onboarding service provider today. The new data goes to the CSP.
effect.EBW: The core data of this company comes from its Business Wallet. Only the identifiers that were declared can change by request; on approval they change at once.

review.auditNote: Opening a document is written to the audit log.
review.decisionText: Approve to change the data of {{company}}, or decline with a reason.
review.approveHelp: Only in the audit log, up to 1000 characters. The company does not see it.
review.declineText: The data of the company stays as it is. The Company Admin sees your reason.
review.approved: Approved. The data of {{company}} is changed ({{date}}).
review.declined: Declined ({{date}}). Reason for the Company Admin: “{{reason}}”
